reviewer: Codex - Crown optimistic selection regression review

reviews.reason: The remaining authenticated Crown optimistic CPU update now follows the existing selection retention rule. A surviving friendly selection stays selected; the player still explicitly chooses a legal destination on their turn. Existing instructions, hint behavior, clocks and ticket policies are unchanged.
evidence: docs/crown-selection-20261030.md: eight baseline resets and ten passing real-component Crown browser scenarios with synthetic account/transport/CPU timing.
src/components/LocalGameBoard.tsx: only the optimistic Crown selection setter changes; turn, pending, legality and authoritative update guards are unchanged.
The existing guide/FAQ piece-then-destination instructions, QUBE teaching, promotion/castling and cosmetic guidance do not require changes for a retained selection.
156 related unit cases and typecheck pass. Prior guest-only browser coverage is explicitly corrected in docs/cpu-selection-20261030.md.
